name: Compressors
description: Replacement options matched to unit make and capacity.
long_description: The compressor is the heart of every AC: it pressurises refrigerant and drives the cooling cycle. We help match rotary, reciprocating and scroll compressors to your unit's capacity, refrigerant and electrical supply so the replacement runs reliably.
